steps.what: Read the product spec and the site limits
Decide the route for these processing plants
Write each unit duty with flow temperature and material
Compute vessel volume and heater duty from that duty
Check each computed figure against the duty she wrote
Design the equipment arrangement with the project team

tasks.design: She still chooses the route for the processing plants and designs the equipment arrangement with the project team. The work removed is the hand multiplication of vessel volume and heater duty from flow, residence time and temperatures she has already written on the unit duty. Copying those figures into {DOCS} is not counted, because that save does not replace a second entry or a transport.
tasks.previous_blocker: The route depends on the material and the site, which a volume formula cannot see.
tasks.enabler_now: Once she writes flow, residence time, material and temperatures as fields, those fields can be multiplied by a fixed formula.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the route, and signing an arrangement the formula did not draw.
tasks.human_edge: She is the person who knows whether this material can run in that plant, and she signs the arrangement.

ambition.what: She compares two residence times on the same duty before she freezes the route.

tasks.altitude: Her week still holds the route decision and the equipment arrangement. Only the hand multiplication of volume and heater duty leaves.

reach.task: Size a shared reactor from a duty this engineer already wrote.
reach.learn: Read flow, temperature and material from her duty instead of asking her to restate them.

evidence.claim: Vessel volume from flow times residence time, and heater duty from mass flow, specific heat and temperature rise, is arithmetic once she has written those fields. The plant route and the equipment arrangement are not that arithmetic.
The Machinery Regulation covers AI safety functions from 20 January 2027.
Multiplying flow, residence time and temperatures she wrote is not an AI safety function of a machine.
The engineer who signs the plant arrangement stays responsible for it.

assumptions: The producer of the formula inputs is the materials engineer in s3. The fields are flow, residence time, material name, inlet temperature and outlet temperature. If those fields are missing, s4 does not run and she multiplies by hand.
The work removed is that multiplication. There is no second system and no send. A later paste of the figures into the design note in {DOCS} is the same note, not removed work.
She keeps the density and specific-heat figures the formula uses. That upkeep is her time, counted in incremental hours.
Standard design software is not assumed. The arithmetic today is on paper beside the duty.
unknowns: Whether this plant's vessels follow a residence-time formula or are one-off equipment with no fixed equation.
Whether the arrangement is a safety component in road, water, gas, heating or electricity supply, which would change the legal frame for any later model.
research_questions: For the last five vessels she sized, how many used the residence-time formula and how many were custom?

already_counted.description: Reading the spec, choosing the route, writing the duty, checking figures and designing the arrangement stay in s1, s2, s3, s5 and s6.

incremental.description: She keeps the density and specific-heat figures the volume formula uses.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A run of repeat tanks where the residence-time formula applies is the high case. A one-off plant with no fixed equation is the low case, and s4 does not run.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the test results the talk will use
Decide which findings the talk will defend
Draft abstract sentences from those findings

loop.input: Findings pack: claim sentences, numbers, units and test ids she wrote.
loop.check: Every number and unit appears in a finding she wrote, and a sentence that adds a result not in the pack fails.
loop.stop: One pass, or two failed checks, then she writes the abstract herself.
loop.why_not_simpler: The abstract is free text, so a fixed template cannot tell whether a sentence adds a result.

steps.what: Review the abstract against the test results
Re-enter the checked abstract on the conference portal
Present technical information while attending conferences
Answer questions from the room after the talk

tasks.design: She still chooses the findings and presents technical information at conferences. The work removed is assembling abstract sentences from the findings pack she wrote, and re-typing that checked abstract into the conference submission portal, a second system from {DOCS}. The talk and the room's questions stay with her. A save of the notes in {DOCS} is not counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: The talk is a room of people, and the findings are hers to defend.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can assemble sentences from a pack she wrote, and the checked text can be re-entered on the organiser's portal.
tasks.still_hard: Standing there and answering a challenge to a number.
tasks.human_edge: She is the person in the room who can defend a number when someone challenges it.
tasks.altitude: She still decides the findings and gives the talk. Sentence assembly and the portal re-entry leave only when she submits an abstract.

reach.task: Prepare a poster from the same findings pack.
reach.learn: Use only findings she listed, and do not add a result the abstract check would fail.

evidence.claim: Assembling abstract sentences from findings she listed is drafting. Standing at a conference and answering the room is not that drafting.
A writing study of 453 professionals measured writing time on its own tasks. That study is not a conference talk, so its reported saving is not applied here.
Article 50 of the EU AI Act applies from 2 August 2026.
A published abstract that a model helped draft should say so, and she reviews the text before it leaves the organisation.

assumptions: The producer of the findings pack is the materials engineer in s2. Fields are claim sentence, number, unit and test id. With no pack, s3 does not run.

The work removed in s3 is writing those abstract sentences. The work removed in s5 is re-typing the checked abstract into the conference submission portal, which is a second system from {DOCS}. The share is that re-entry, not the talk.
If she gives an invited talk and submits nothing, s5 does not run. Saving the abstract inside {DOCS} is not removed work.
The talk and the answers are spoken, so they are not a gated send. She keeps the portal field list (title, authors, abstract) matched to her sections; that upkeep is her time.
The draft log stores document ids, not a score of her hours. If a later use scores her output, national works-council rules apply and are not decided here.
unknowns: Whether this year's conferences use a submission portal separate from {DOCS}, or only an invitation with no re-entry.
Whether the abstract is published in a form that must carry an assistance disclosure.
research_questions: Of her last four conference appearances, how many required a portal submission and how many were invited talks with no form?

already_counted.description: Reading results, choosing findings, reviewing the abstract, giving the talk and answering the room stay in s1, s2, s4, s6 and s7.

incremental.description: She keeps the conference portal field list matched to her abstract sections.

approvals.approved_version: The abstract text she checked in s4, bound to the findings pack: claim sentences, numbers, units and test ids. Any later edit voids the portal re-entry.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A year with one submitted abstract, where she keeps the drafted sentences, is the high case. An invited talk with no portal, or a pack too thin to draft from, is the low case.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write for journals and trade publications

steps.what: Read results and the papers this article answers
Choose technical magazines journals or trade association publications
Write the article sentences from her claim list

loop.input: Claim list: claim sentence, number, unit, result id and citation id she wrote.
loop.output: Article sentences with those ids beside each number.
loop.check: Every number and unit appears in a claim she wrote, and a sentence that adds a finding or a citation not in the list fails.
loop.stop: One pass, or two failed checks, then she writes the article herself.
loop.why_not_simpler: The article is free text, so a fixed template cannot tell whether a sentence adds a finding.

steps.what: Check every number unit and citation in the draft
Re-enter the checked manuscript on the publisher portal
Answer the editor on the points she accepts

tasks.design: She still chooses the claims and the outlet, and she still answers the editor. The work removed is drafting article sentences from the claim list she wrote, and re-typing the checked manuscript into the publisher portal, a second system from {DOCS}. A save of the draft inside {DOCS} is not counted. The editor reply is her own text and is not a machine send.
tasks.previous_blocker: The claims are her judgement, and a writing study of other professions does not measure this article.
tasks.enabler_now: Prose can be drafted from a claim list where every number must trace to a result she listed, and the checked file can be re-entered on the publisher portal.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding which result is true enough to publish, and what the editor is actually asking.
tasks.human_edge: She decides which result is worth publishing and what she will not claim.

ambition.what: She can issue a short trade note when a test finishes, where she now waits to write a full paper by hand.

tasks.altitude: She still chooses claims and answers the editor. Sentence drafting and the publisher re-entry leave when she submits.

reach.task: Draft a short trade note from the same claim list.
reach.learn: Keep each number tied to a result id she wrote, and add no finding the check would fail.

evidence.claim: A draft that must trace each number to a result she listed can be checked by reading the list. Choosing the claim cannot.
A writing study of 453 professionals measured writing time on its own tasks. That figure is not this engineer's saving; her check of every number remains.
A department asked for a research article to be withdrawn and said it had no confidence in the data. The article check therefore fails any sentence that adds a result absent from her claim list.
Article 50 of the EU AI Act applies from 2 August 2026.
A published article that a model helped draft should say so, and she reviews it before it leaves the organisation.

assumptions: The producer of the claim list is the materials engineer in s2. Fields are claim sentence, number, unit, result id and citation id. With no list, s3 does not run.

The work removed in s3 is writing the article sentences. The work removed in s5 is re-typing the checked manuscript into the publisher portal, a second system from {DOCS}. The share is that re-entry, not the article's thinking and not a save inside {DOCS}.
If she writes no article, or the publisher has no separate portal, s5 does not run. The editor reply in s6 is her own judgement, written and sent by her, and is not treated as removed work.
She keeps the publisher field list and the citation style the draft must follow. That upkeep is her time. The draft log stores document ids, not a score of her hours.
unknowns: Whether the magazine or journal she uses has a portal separate from {DOCS}.
Whether a trade association wants a posted file rather than a portal form, which would change what s5 re-enters.
research_questions: For her last three articles, was the submission a second portal, an email attachment, or a file already in {DOCS}?

already_counted.description: Reading, choosing the outlet and claims, checking the manuscript and answering the editor stay in s1, s2, s4 and s6.

incremental.description: She keeps the publisher portal field list and the citation style the draft must follow.

approvals.approved_version: The manuscript text she checked in s4, bound to the claim list: claim sentences, numbers, units, result ids and citation ids. Any later edit voids the publisher re-entry.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A quarter with one trade article whose drafted sentences she keeps, and a publisher portal separate from {DOCS}, is the high case. A quarter with no submission, or a portal that is the same store, is the low case.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still chooses the process route, signs the equipment arrangement, stands at conferences, and picks the claims in a paper. Hand arithmetic of vessel volume and heater duty, abstract sentences from a pack she wrote, a checked conference-portal re-entry, article sentences from her claims, and a checked publisher re-entry leave the week when those steps apply.
reach: Chemical engineers can reuse her duty fields, flow, temperature and material, instead of re-interviewing her for the same numbers.
Mechanical drafters can trace the equipment arrangement she signed instead of guessing vessel sizes.
skills_to_grow: Write a unit duty as flow, residence time, material and temperatures before any volume is computed.
Reject an abstract or article sentence that states a result missing from her pack.
role.ambitious_version: No unattended agent chooses the process route, signs the plant, gives the conference talk, or picks the claims in a paper.
